name: Default Shooting
description: Considerable boost to Shooting attributes when in Takeover.

name: Shot Artist
description: Enhances ability to make Off-Dribble shots.

name: Calibrated
description: Enhances ability to make Set shots.

name: Zip Code
description: Extends ability to make shots from Deep.

name: Default Finishing
description: Considerable boost to Finishing attributes when in Takeover.

name: Navigator
description: Enhances ability to make Driving and Advanced layups (euros, hops, spins).

name: Airspace
description: Enhances ability to make Driving dunks.

name: Inside Touch
description: Enhances ability to make Standing layups.

name: Detonator
description: Enhances ability to make Standing dunks.

name: Paint Surgeon
description: Enhances ability to make Post Hooks, Fades, and win matchups in the post.

name: Default Playmaking
description: Considerable boost to Playmaking attributes when in Takeover.

name: Blur
requirement: 85 Ball Handle AND 80 Speed With Ball
description: Enhances ability to blow by defenders and win body-up matchups.

name: Cook
description: Increases chances of successful ankle breakers.

name: Dishmaster
description: Increases boosts to pass recipient's Finishing and Shooting attributes.

name: Default Defense
description: Considerable boost to Defense attributes when in Takeover.

name: Glue
description: Enhances ability to force ball pickups and fumbles.

name: Hawk
description: Activates on-ball steal attempts that can cause turnovers or force fumbles.

name: Rim Guardian
description: Increases ability to win post and off-ball post situations, and activates elite shot blocking around the rim.

name: Default Rebounding
description: Considerable boost to Rebounding attributes when in Takeover.

name: Demolition
description: Increases ability to set strong screens.

name: Muscle
requirement: 80 Offensive Rebound AND 80 Defensive Rebound AND 80 Strength
description: Increases ability to win successful boxouts and rebounds.

name: Second Chance
description: Instantly see shot feedback on all shots, and increase ability to make successful putbacks.

name: See the Future
description: Shows you where missed shots will land ahead of time.

name: Hydration Hero
description: Temporarily disables losing adrenaline and energy/turbo. Can be equipped in any of the five Takeover Ability discipline slots.
